description: This is a retro-style television with a thick, olive-green casing. It features a curved screen with a static or grainy display, suggesting it's either off or tuned to a non-existent channel. Two silver, flexible antennas with colorful, spherical tips extend from the top. Below the screen, there are several buttons and a small red circular control. A matching olive-green remote control with numerous buttons lies to the right of the television. The overall aesthetic is reminiscent of older cathode-ray tube televisions, evoking a sense of nostalgia.
